headline: HOMEBODY BONDS — conversations now count for something
lede: The people sim's chat loop grew a ladder: two bonds (heart = the household, leaf = the neighbour Fern) climb while people actually talk, unlock warmer topics and longer visits, and quietly cool when nobody invests.

notes.text: BONDS (#1817): four levels ACQUAINTED to FAMILY on the needs panel; Fern at FAMILY arrives sooner, stays later, and stops making small talk; payday becomes a toast once the two residents are close. 83 peoplecheck gates + 25 real-Chrome gates, mutation-proven.
HOMEBODY also grew the Spare Room (#1806) this morning — the lot expands east with a plank-floored wing, punched doorway and lit-ready windows, one per lot.

Calibration caught on the drive, not in node: the first fade spec outran chat growth once a sim-hour became five real seconds. A meter that only a solver can climb is a meter nobody sees. Values now sit well under growth per real second.
QA lane: BOMB DEFUSE shipped its two-hand co-op (#1811) and MAGIC CARPET opened its spell book (#1810); FIRE CREW got its ladder truck back (#1813).
